question:
**Direction: Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

To renounce a throne
solution: The correct answer is **"Abdicate."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"To renounce a throne"** means to give up or relinquish a position of power or authority. (सत्ता या प्राधिकार का पद त्यागना या छोड़ देना) • **Example**: *The ageing founder of the firm decided **to renounce his throne**__.* • The word **'abdicate'** means to renounce or give up a throne, position, or responsibility. (किसी सिंहासन, पद या जिम्मेदारी को त्यागना या छोड़ देना) __ • **Example**: *King Edward VIII **abdicated**__ the throne in 1936 to marry Wallis Simpson. * • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Option 1 **(Avow)** means to declare or admit openly or publicly. (दृढ़ता से खुले आम कुछ कहना, स्‍वीकार करना) • Option 2 **(Abort)** means to terminate or cancel something before it is completed. (किसी कार्य को पूरा होने के पूर्व समाप्‍त कर देना) • Option 3** (Assert) **means to state or declare something confidently or forcefully. (स्‍पष्‍ट रूप से और बलपूर्वक कुछ कहना) 2f:Tb18, The correct answer is **"begun."**
